name: AlphAI
tagline: Financial news for AI agents and trading bots
description: Pre-analyzed financial news and SEC insider data. Every story carries per-ticker impact, a category and a 1-10 relevance score, so an agent filters before it reads. Full-text news search, stories across publishers, 8-K and 6-K earnings reads, Form 4 insider trades, the US macro calendar and news alerts. Hosted, OAuth sign-in, free tier (20 requests/min, 100/day, no card).
